blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Press freedom and journalism watchdog Center for Media Freedom and Responsibility (CMFR) has announced that it will be closing down its operations effective Sept. 30. “Philippine and international funding support has sustained the work of CMFR,” the center said in a statement on its social media page on Friday. “But, multiple factors have affected the funding environment, making it difficult for CMFR to secure the necessary funds for its operations,” it explained. EMBED: CMFR was formed in 1989 aiming to “uphold press freedom, promote responsible journalism, and encourage journalistic excellence.” READ: Duterte’s tirades vs. media take highest office […]...
